## RBAC (Simple)

Each user has one `role`: `"user"` or `"admin"`. Protect a route with:

```js
router.get("/admin-check", requireAuth, requireRole("admin"), handler);
```

See `routes/admin.routes.js` for a working example (`GET /api/v1/admin-check`).
